messages:
matt_chang: Heads-up — I repro'd a nasty deferred-allocation path hitting the KV pager under a flash-variant + fused-attn mixed workload. Observed big p99 regression and fragmentation growth. Logs attached below. :grimacing:

sara_ng: Can you paste the trace snippet? :eyes:

matt_chang: ```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] pager: try_defer_alloc=1 deferred_alloc_enqueued=1 slab_alloc_failed=0 fallback_alloc=1
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] kv_pager: page_faults=234 inflight_batches=64 max_batch_expected=8
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] kernel-chooser: selected=flashv2 reason="low_avg_seq"
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] runtime: batch_exec_latency_ms=370 p99
```

kevin_lopez: Is this the classic mismatch where the kernel selector prefers flash for short-average sequences, then a burst of long sequences causes KV paging+deferred alloc and backpressure?

julia_hart: Can you share the command you used to reproduce?

matt_chang: ```
./perf-run --model t5-large --variant flashv2 --seq 2048 --concurrency 64 --prefix_cache=rand:0.2 --kv_pager_policy=defer_alloc
```

sara_ng: My hypothesis: defer_alloc + sticky kernel chooser -> when the spike hits, allocator delays slab commits, inflight batches pile up, kernel stays flash (incompatible for heavy paging), hitting lots of context switches and large p99s.

kevin_lopez: Potential mitigations: 1) kernel selector should include inflight_batch_count and kv_page_fault_rate in decision; 2) ban defer_alloc when inflight > threshold; 3) pre-allocate a tiny hot slab for unexpected long-seq spikes.

matt_chang: Quick numbers: baseline p99 ~120ms, repro p99 ~370ms, overall throughput down ~30%. Fragmentation metric +1.8x over 5m.

julia_hart: Can we try a patched selector: if kv_page_fault_rate > 0.05 then force kernel=fused as an experiment? Cheap to toggle and should reduce paging latency.

sara_ng: Also add a short telemetry annotation "kv_pager.deferred_alloc" so console rollouts can surface this as a potential regression cause.

ci-bot: Deploy preview created: kv-selector-heuristic-2026-03-15. Perf job queued (job id: perf-3109876558).

matt_chang: Note for follow-up: add a unit that simulates short->long seq spike while defer_alloc is enabled; add metrics: deferred_alloc_count, kernel_choice_during_pager, pager_blocked_duration.

sara_ng: SGTM. I'll take the telemetry work. Thanks for the repro and logs. :thumbsup:
